rationale: TI Hungary publishes recurring public-procurement analytics (single-bid rates, tender champions) that interpret HU award patterns.
Commercially motivated POS/acquiring comparison blog; useful vendor map but low credibility, revisit later.
Single-vendor payments blog with strong bias and little tender signal; weak standalone value.
Canonical roster of Hungarian banks — mine once to build the buyer-side contracting-authority universe for A2.
Working-group page is a section of bankszovetseg.hu already covered by monitoring the parent association site.
Fintech association membership roster enumerates likely bidders/subcontractors on HU bank and payments tenders.
IVSZ member directory maps the ICT integrator/software vendor pool bidding on financial-sector IT tenders.
Dated association news feed giving incremental signals on new digital suppliers entering the market.
Year-specific bank-IT conference sponsor roster: mine per-year tiers as a supplier-intensity series, not a live feed.
Portfolio event catalogue is the standing index for harvesting all HU banking/payments conference sponsor and speaker lists.
Publisher corporate news adds only forward calendar hints already covered by the Portfolio event catalogue.
IIR event calendar continuously lists card-market/payments conferences and their commercial partners — recurring supplier signal.
Kártyapiac microsite likely holds partner/exhibitor lists but URL check failed; re-verify liveness before mining.
FinTechShow exhibitor/sponsor gallery is a curated catalogue of vendors selling into Hungarian financial institutions.
Fintech week tag page surfaces smaller hosts and partner firms absent from major sponsor tiers; mine once per edition.
Third-party event aggregator entry duplicating organiser data; only a fallback cross-check.
Valuable sector-tagged member directory of banks and IT vendors, but chamber directories typically require member login.
~900-company bilateral chamber directory covering German-owned banks/IT suppliers; full listing usually gated by registration.
Near-complete national chamber registry for resolving and enriching supplier identities named in award notices.
County chamber front-end over the same national registry; redundant with MKIK unless different exports are confirmed.
Leasing association member list is an adjacent buyer universe for payments/IT procurement; mine once and refresh yearly.
Small technology association with thin, indirect connection to bank/payments tenders.
Association-of-associations index; useful only as a one-off cross-index for discovering further trade bodies.
Static IT-history archive entry — reference material for resolving legacy vendor names, not a producing signal source.
LinkedIn org pages need login and scraping is against ToS; legally and practically blocked despite some unique event/partner content.
One-off trade-press article on a conference; URL check failed and value is limited to background colour.
Filterable bank/insurance job listings are an early fingerprint of upcoming or awarded core-banking and payments contracts.
